dialogue.text: You must be a new traveler. Allow me to give you some useful instructions. To speak to NPCs like me, just click on us. To move, press the left and right arrow keys and jump. Go on and try it! Also, sometimes you may need to climb a ladder or use a rope to reach your destination. You can do that by pressing the up arrow. This is important information, so remember it well.
